databases.description: List of dictionaries to serve. Each entry defines a dictionary by name and optional human-readable title.

name.description: The base filename (without .index/.dict extensions) of the dictionary data.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for this dictionary (e.g., 'WordNet 2.0').

access_rules.description: Access control rules. Applied in order: allow/deny patterns (supports wildcards and CIDR).

action.description: Whether to allow or deny matching clients.

pattern.description: Client pattern (IP/CIDR like '192.168.1.0/24' or hostname like '*.edu').

rate_limit.description: Rate-limiting configuration per client to prevent abuse.

max_queries.description: Maximum allowed queries per client within the window.

window.description: Time window (in seconds) for rate counting.

bind.description: IP:port to bind the server to (e.g., '127.0.0.1:2628' to restrict locally).

clienttimeout.description: Idle timeout (seconds) before disconnecting a client.

defaultdb.description: Default database to query if none specified by the client. Use 'all' to query all enabled databases.

motd.description: Custom Message of the Day to display upon client connection (single-line text). Leave empty for none.
